scope: Frozen blind inputs and their declared local source/function provenance. No blind-lane output was opened or read; no normative/source change, browser activity, database write, or heavy verification was performed.

raw_rank_preservation.source_map_parity: Each 99-rank source-map sequence equals neutral-packet raw_name order; no rank gap or count mismatch found.

canonicalization_and_parentheticals.source_scoped_only: function-provenance.json and both function supplements identify source-specific lookups; they do not register generic aliases.
canonicalization_and_parentheticals.parts_and_derivatives: Raw names remain in the packet. Examples checked: BC02 seed/fruit/bark/leaf/flower/resin distinctions, BC03 Hydrogenated Castor Oil/Sebacic Acid Copolymer, and BC04 Brahmi Herpestis Fruit Extract.
canonicalization_and_parentheticals.absolute_qualifier: BC04 rank 7 retains raw 'Jasminum Officinale (Jasmin Absolute) Oil' and canonical 'JASMINUM OFFICINALE (JASMIN ABSOLUTE) OIL'.
canonicalization_and_parentheticals.markers: Tabitha * and ** plus Fushi epsilon markers remain in raw names; marker notes do not create extra ranks or percentages.

function_role_boundaries.keratins: Only HYDROLYZED KERATIN carries film_forming. KERATIN, Hydrolyzed Keratin PG-Propyl Methylsilanediol, Cocodimonium Hydroxypropyl Hydrolyzed Keratin, and Laurdimonium Hydroxypropyl Hydrolyzed Keratin do not.
function_role_boundaries.castor_sebacic_copolymer: HYDROGENATED CASTOR OIL/SEBACIC ACID COPOLYMER has conditioning/emollient roles only; it has neither film_forming nor structural_gum.
function_role_boundaries.styrax: STYRAX TONKINENSIS RESIN EXTRACT is fragrance/skin_conditioning only; it is not assumed to be a structural gum.
function_role_boundaries.provenance_parity: Every packet rank has a function-dictionary entry and a matching function-provenance record; zero missing entries and zero role mismatches.

material_priors.scope: Pure-material tendencies only; never percentages or finished-formula labels.
material_priors.identity_limits: Checked selected exact botanical priors retain plant part/form restrictions, including separate Hippophae seed versus fruit/seed, whole Cocos versus processed derivatives, and exact source-scoped botanical aliases.

method_and_blinding.formula_ids: BC01, BC02, BC03, and BC04 match input-manifest formula identifiers.
method_and_blinding.brand_marketing_absence: No selected brand/product identifier, URL, web-reference, or source-field marker occurs in the four frozen inputs.

meaningful_limits_retained: All blend judgments remain estimates with low confidence; ingredient order is qualitative and supplies no percentages, trace boundary, or mass weighting.
Generic functions do not establish dose, deposition, retention, hair performance, persistence, fit, or finished-product weight.
BC04's published Brahmi Herpestis wording remains raw and not_assessed; no correction or alias was invented.
US/UK source and package-equivalence limits remain outside the blind packet and unchanged from source preflight.
